title: matelea altatensis
intro: Matelea altatensis, commonly known as the "Coral Milkweed," is a flowering plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and combating infections. The therapeutic actions of Matelea altatensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit neuroprotective effects, and show promise in treating certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified through various studies.
